thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: P0 - Edge API header regression detected. 5xx rate rising from ~1% to ~12% over 5m for /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Alert: https://alerts/redwood/EDGE-HEADER-REG-452 :rotating_light:
elaine-oncall: Acknowledged, I'm oncall. Starting initial triage.
jamie-eng: I can see 502s from edge-proxy -> header-transform service. Error spikes align with the edge-header-v2 rollout (~10m ago) in eu-west.
elaine-oncall: Ok. Mitigation plan: 1) flip feature flag for edge-header-v2 2) if needed, rollback canary in eu-west. Applying kill-switch now.
elaine-oncall: Command I'm running: 
```
curl -X POST "https://featureflags.internal/api/flags/edge-header-v2" \  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" \  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \  -d '{"enabled":false}'
```
ops-lead: Also preparing rollback command in case kill-switch doesn't drop errors:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/header-transform --to-revision=3
```
jamie-eng: Logs from header-transform: "panic: runtime error: index out of range" on request with header Content-Length: 5120. Stack shows new parser path introduced in v2.
rahul-devex: Customer impact: embeddings tenants (3 top clients) are seeing ~30% failed requests in eu-west, several support tickets incoming. We should include customers in the incident ticket.
elaine-oncall: Kill-switch applied. Observability: 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 3% within 60s but not to baseline. Kicking rollback for eu-west canary now.
jamie-eng: Rollback started. Patch applied to header-transform replicas in eu-west.
jamie-eng: Rollback complete in eu-west canary. Metrics: 5xxs down to ~0.6% (baseline ~0.5%). Latency normalizing.
sre-bot: Incident note: timeline updated, tags: edge, deploy, rollback, customer-impact. Creating INC-2026-042.
elaine-oncall: Good. Followups: - keep monitoring for 1h - gather example failing requests (sanitized) - schedule postmortem and RCA. Handoff to @jamie-eng for next hour monitoring.
jamie-eng: Ack, I'll monitor dashboards and paging for 1h, will escalate if anything regresses.
elaine-oncall: Thanks everyone. Filing the initial incident summary in the ticket and pinging support to notify affected customers. :white_check_mark:
rahul-devex: Noted, I'll coordinate customer comms and collect error samples.
sre-bot: Handoff recorded: oncall -> jamie-eng at 5523458000.
jamie-eng: closing active mitigation. Leaving this thread open for notes and postmortem links.
